attempts.text:
**The window starts in the glycine cleavage system.** Columns 0 to 1, `gcvH` and `gcvP`, are spine, carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, and never in a region of plasticity: 0% in a region of plasticity. The model names them in 99.6 to 100% of calls and hesitates less than 0.06 bits.

**A variable column follows at `ygfF`**, column 2, named in 41% of calls. Then columns 3 to 15 are spine, `bglA` to `idi`, carried by 93 to 95% of chromosomes, with the model naming 91 to 99.6% and hesitating most at `idi`, 0.42 bits. Column 16 is variable and the most plastic of the window: 97% in a region of plasticity, a hypothetical protein in 84% of chromosomes.

**Columns 17 to 18 are spine**, `yqfG` and `uacT`, named in 76 to 81% of calls. Then columns 19 to 36 are variable, 17 shell families and 1 persistent, carried by 82 to 86% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 88 to 95% of calls; the model names 73 to 98%, fewest at column 23. Column 37 is spine, `xdhC`, named in 97%.

**Hesitation peaks at the fork at `yqeF`**, column 41: 2.00 bits, 74% in a region of plasticity, named 73%; its branch carries a transposase and a toxin family. The spine at columns 42 to 43, `kduI` and `kduD`, is named in 72 to 81%. Then 36 fork and variable columns run to `ygdI`, 16 to 67% in a region of plasticity, named 83 to 95%; branches there carry [[type III secretion proteins]] at columns 45 to 48 and 54 to 56, and [[glycine cleavage system genes]] at columns 77 to 79.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 0.69 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 88% against 95%. Over the whole window it names 91% of genes, 0.43 bits on average.

label: gcvH
facts:
WINDOW: the gcvH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gcvH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 831 to 910 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gcvH once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.43 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 22,843 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; shell 19,743 calls, named 87%, 0.66 bits; cloud 614 calls, named 16%, 3.90 bits. Outside an RGP 20,919 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 22,281 calls, named 88%, 0.69 bits. Columns: 21 spine, 24 fork, 35 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.69 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (88% against 95%); 22,281 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 41 (yqeF) 2.00 bits, RGP 74%; column 42 (kduI) 1.64 bits, RGP 72%; column 43 (kduD) 1.25 bits, RGP 69%. The 44 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 90%, 0.58 bits on average; the other 36 columns: named 93%, 0.26 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 16 (variable), RGP 97%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: gcvH, gcvP "aminomethyl-transferring glycine de…". named 99.6-100% (mean 99.8%), fewest named at column 1 (gcvP), named 99.6%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.06 bits (column 1 (gcvP)).
2. column 2 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 41%; 0.79 bits.
   2: ygfF S 53% "SDR family NAD(P)-dependent oxidore…"
3. columns 3-15 (13 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 0.2-97%. Genes: bglA, yqfB "N(4)-acetylcytidine aminohydrolase", trhA, ygfZ "tRNA-modifying protein YgfZ", sdhE, ygfX "protein YgfX", fldB, xerD, dsbC, recJ, prfB, lysS, idi. named 91-99.6% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 15 (idi), named 91%, 0.42 bits.
4. column 16 variable: RGP 97%. named 95%; 0.45 bits.
   16: "hypothetical protein" S 84%
5. columns 17-18 (2 columns) spine: share 90-93%, 1 P, 1 S, RGP 97%. Genes: yqfG "protein YqfG", uacT. named 76-81% (mean 78%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18 (uacT), named 76%, 0.83 bits.
6. columns 19-36 (18 columns) variable: RGP 88-95%. named 73-98% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 23, named 73%; most hesitant at column 19, 0.74 bits.
   columns 19-36, share 82-86%, 17 S, 1 P: ygfT "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…" 86%, ygfS "4Fe-4S binding protein" 85%, ghxQ 86%, guaD 86%, xanQ 85%, xdhD 85%, ygfM 86%, ssnA 86%, ygfK "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase" 85%, mocA 86%, yqeC "selenium cofactor biosynthesis prot…" 85%, yqeB "XdhC family protein" 85%, arcC 85%, hyuA 85%, ygeY 85%, dpaL 85%, ygeW "knotted carbamoyltransferase YgeW" 85%, ygeV "sigma-54-dependent Fis family trans…" 82%
7. column 37 spine: share 90%, all S, RGP 88%. Genes: xdhC "xanthine dehydrogenase iron sulfur-…". named 97%; 0.29 bits.
8. columns 38-39 (2 columns) variable: RGP 76-87%. named 93-95% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 39, named 93%, 0.53 bits.
   38: xdhB S 89%
   39: xdhA S 88%
9. column 40 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 76%. Genes: actS. named 82%; 1.25 bits.
10. column 41 fork: RGP 74%. named 73%; 2.00 bits.
   41: yqeF P 90% "acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase"; also ygeQ S 57%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 38%, "GhoT/OrtT family toxin" S 22%
11. columns 42-43 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 69-72%. Genes: kduI "5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronate iso…", kduD. named 72-81% (mean 77%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 42 (kduI), named 72%, 1.64 bits.
12. columns 44-79 (36 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 16-67%. named 83-95% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 44, named 83%, 1.15 bits.
